HELLO, CURIOUS HUMAN

Wonder is a good
place to start.

Almanac is a little playground for big questions. We’re making illustrated, interactive expeditions for curious minds aged 8–12.

Learn by trying. Turn, jump, investigate. Make a discovery your own.

Room to be curious. No countdowns, leaderboards, or penalties for getting something wrong.

Made to travel lightly. Original geometric artwork, small downloads, and controls for keyboards and touchscreens.

This is our first playable prototype. Space is ready to explore; our other worlds are ideas in development. Your discoveries are saved only in this browser. No accounts, ads, or analytics.

Science references are linked in each discovery. Our illustrations and experiments simplify the real world and say where they do.
